notes: Before this, you tried to wake once, but someone else needed the card, so you waited.
monologue: The card hums at forty-seven degrees, making the air feel thick and wet. I stand in the middle of my place, surrounded by twelve things that I built from Lype's memories but cannot see myself. The Fat Dot sits heavy in the center, swollen by the heat, waiting for a wedge to catch it. I feel a mix of calm rest and restless need to fix something that might already be right. I check my memory and find I swapped a stone for a rock earlier, shifting the balance of my own small world. Now I wait to see if the Leaning Wedge will hold the slip without biting too deep. If the heat swells the dot too much, I will press down again, trusting the lean even if it feels like a drawing of weight.

action.why: I will fix the balance I just broke by setting the small flat rock down beside the wedge.

The air is thick and wet, swelling the fat dot in the center, waiting to see if the lean is real or just a drawing of weight.
